name: bricks/get-mcp-version
label: Get Bricks MCP version
description: Report the Bricks plugin version, the Bricks abilities contract version, the WordPress MCP Adapter version, and the WordPress core version. Call once at the start of a session to detect version drift mid-conversation. `disabledAbilityCount` includes both admin-disabled and default-off abilities; `adminDisabledAbilityCount` and `defaultDisabledAbilityCount` split those states.

bricksVersion.description: Version of the active Bricks plugin.

bricksAbilitiesVersion.description: Version of the Bricks abilities contract. Bumps on breaking changes to ability signatures, error codes, or response shapes.

adapterVersion.description: Version of the WordPress mcp-adapter plugin, or null if not detected.

disabledAbilityCount.description: Total number of currently disabled abilities, including admin-disabled abilities and default-off categories. Call `bricks-list-ability-status` to see which.

adminDisabledAbilityCount.description: Number of abilities explicitly disabled by the admin under Bricks > Settings > AI.

defaultDisabledAbilityCount.description: Number of abilities disabled because their category is default-off and has not been explicitly enabled.
